meta.name: social-listening-brief
meta.description: Use when the user wants a social listening report about what people are saying about a brand, person, product, topic, category, or niche across public social platforms. Produces cited themes, sentiment caveats, notable posts, and recommended actions.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 追踪社交平台讨论，生成带引用的口碑洞察报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要了解品牌或产品在社交平台上的真实讨论与口碑。
copy.tagline_en: Generate cited social listening reports on any brand or topic.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need fast, cited insights into brand and product buzz on social media.

howto.what: Claude 会按你的主题去搜索 Reddit、TikTok 等公开平台的讨论，把提到的事情按主题归类，区分正向、负向、中性或混合情绪，挑出代表性帖子和建议行动，最后生成一份「Social Listening Brief」报告。
howto.when: 当用户询问“人们怎么说某品牌/产品”或要求监测某个品牌、话题时触发。

say.text: 帮我出一份关于『某品牌』的社交倾听简报。
say.note: Claude 会搜索公开平台并生成带主题和情绪的报告。

say.text: 最近 Reddit 上对这款新产品有什么评价？总结成主题。
say.note: 它会基于搜索结果整理帖子、引语和行动建议。

say.text: 监测一下这个人物在社交平台的舆情，列出主要风险和机会。

howto.what_en: Claude will search public social platforms for the given topic, cluster conversations into themes, separate sentiment signals, highlight notable posts, and produce a Social Listening Brief with cited themes, sentiment caveats, and recommended actions.
howto.when_en: Use when user wants a social listening report about a brand, person, product, topic, category, or niche across public platforms.

say_en.text: Create a social listening brief for [Brand].
say_en.note: Claude will search public sources and generate a themed report.

say_en.text: Summarize recent Reddit comments about this new product into themes.
say_en.note: The report will include representative posts and quotes.

say_en.text: Monitor public sentiment about this person and list key risks and opportunities.
say_en.note: Output includes a Risks / Opportunities section.
